_schema.purpose: Where the system-under-test builds are read from for each environment (triage plan E7). scripts/triage/collect-versions.js fetches each app's page, finds its JavaScript bundle and reads the build identity the build inlines (GITHUB_SHA, BUILD_TIME, GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER, GITHUB_REF_NAME, GITHUB_REPOSITORY). See docs/strategy/Test-Report-Dashboard-and-Triage-Plan.md §4.2.
_schema.environments: Environment name (configs/env) -> apps. An environment with no apps records no versions.
_schema.apps.key: Service key from triage/service-map.json; name and repo come from there.
_schema.apps.url: The app's own page (the iframe the portal loads), not the portal route. Find it in a nightly run's network log: the static host that serves <app>/env.js.
_schema.services: The backend services (PO, AI, LM, UI Fields) expose no version through the gateway (2026-11-05: /actuator/* and /v1/version answer 'No API path found'), so they are not listed.
